item.title: COMING THIS FRIDAY | Songs & Seasons: Wisdom, Humor & Music ft. Linda Mitchell, Mark Goldthwaite & Em Hurley — Thu Oct 22 — Kittredge Arts Center
item.description:
Friday, October 23 | 5 PM – 8 PM | Williams Recital Hall | From $36.22 Event Details and Tickets
Join some of Western North Carolina’s Musical Trailblazers as they share their music, histories and amazing stories at the beautiful Williams Recital Hall @ Kittredge Arts Center on the Campus of Warren Wilson College! Three amazing performers: Wondrous Jazz Veteran Linda Mitchell, Father of the MGB’s and Owner of Asheville Guitar Bar Mark Goldthwaite and Ovadya’s Amazing Singer Songwriter Poet Em Hurley. Free hors d’oeuvres come with entry donation.
Nestled within the beautiful, historic Warren Wilson College campus, the Kittredge Arts Center provides a centralized location for the arts at WWC and WNC. The Center features the 321-seat Kittredge Theater and 80-seat Williams Recital Hall, where concerts and other performance events are featured throughout the year.
Source: LiveMusicAsheville.com

item.title: Mountains-to-Sea Trail Highway 25 toward Bent Creek — Fri Oct 23, 9:00 AM
item.description:
Asheville Mountains-to-Sea Trail Hiking Club 2.0 This is a fairly easy hike, and we go at a high average to low advanced speed, which is roughly about 3.0 to 3.2 mph. There are no super long hills. It's pretty undulating all the way.
Well behaved dogs on leashes are welcome to attend.
When you arrive, park at the gravel lot across from the trail head. You'll see some people gathering by their cars. I've recently corrected the PIN setting on the map, so it should be correct. Here are some directions to use too: When going south on Hendersonville Road, go past Carolina Day School and turn right at the Blue Ridge Parkway exit. When you get to the parkway turn RIGHT. You will see parking on the left and right side of the road. Park there.

item.title: AVLH3 #870 - Hashing Into the Sunset (Allegedly) — Sat Oct 24, 4:30 PM
item.description: Asheville Hash House Harriers (AVLH3) 🌅 LATE-BREAKING TRAIL ALERT 🌅 Hashing Into the Sunset (Allegedly) Nobody else wanted it, so your Saturday hares are Crotches (aka Flipper) and Sicilian Family Portrait. Let's just say this trail was planned in haste. We're chasing the sunset to the top of something in North Asheville. Where? That's for us to know and you to stagger toward. Experts are calling it a "spectacularly shitty sunset." Clouds? Haze? An uninspiring smear of beige? Nobody knows. You'll be up there anyway, vessels in hand, looking west, pretending it's gorgeous. 📍 **Start/Finish:** Weaver Park, North Asheville (A-A as stuttering Canadians say) probably. Updates to follow. Strollers and stretchers welcome. 🕔 **Hares away:** 5:00 PM sharp. Pack away around 5:15. 🌇 **Sunset:** 6:43 PM. Get on top or miss it. 🍺 **Beer stops:** Maybe two. Maybe one plus a shot stop. The hares haven't decided and frankly may not before Saturday. 📏 **Distance:** About 4 miles, with a hill at the end

item.title: Cemetery Loop Tr; a Saunter — Sat Oct 31, 10:00 AM
item.description: Hendo Fun Friends **A Walk in the Park;** **This Week: *Cemetery Loop Tr:*** **DESCRIPTION;** *The Cemetery Loop Trail is a pleasant and short footpath which, when combined with the nearby Long Branch Trail offers a quick loop hike into a lesser-visited corner of Pisgah National Forest. Along the way there’s a decent variety of habitats to be seen. The main attraction is the 19th Century Cemetery which it passes at its far eastern extremity. Named the McCall Cemetery, it is named for the family and descendants of Samuel McCall who settled nearby in the late 1700’s. The cemetery sits in a serenely beautiful spot at the base of a low pine covered ridge.* Remember - hikes led by ‘the Curmudgeon’ tend to have pleasant surprises. Due to recent events, Ouija boards are no longer permitted. We are the Sloth Walking team: “We take our time… Up to 12 ppl are welcome to join. (Social ‘hour’ at 10 AM. item.title: Gaming Night @ Noble Cider — Tue Nov 10, 6:00 PM
item.description:
Asheville's Bored Game Geeks Roll the dice and pour a glass! 🎲🍎
Gaming Night is back at Noble Cider! Join us every other Tuesday for a night of tabletop tactics, card-shuffling chaos, and great company. Whether you’re a seasoned strategist or you still think a "meeple" is a type of small fruit, you’re welcome at our table.
### The Lowdown:
* **No Experience? No Problem:** We’re all about community. We’ll help you learn the ropes of a new game or cheer you on while you figure it out. * **The Library:** We have a solid stash of games ready to play—from quick party favorites to deeper strategy titles. * **Bring Your Favorites:** Have a game gathering dust on your shelf? Bring it along! We love seeing what the community is playing. * **The Vibe:** High-quality cider, cozy atmosphere, and just the right amount of competitive spirit.
**Feel Free to bring your own games too!**
Source: Asheville's Bored Game Geeks
